source: simulation scoring of protocol polymer_refine_convergence_r1 (200 new independent polymer_embed families, 100 Ag + 100 Au, exposure x10 = one 0.5 s window)
scope: Exploratory numbers computed after the r1 simulation was scored; not a pre-registered test. Within the hemisphere (h=R) polymer_embed model. Network numbers use all 200 families; refined numbers use converged cases where the parameter was identified (about 73%). typical_rel_scatter = exp(1.4826*MAD(log est/true))-1 (about a 68% band); P90 shows the wrong-branch tail.

burial.verdict: unreliable: refined rank correlation 0.56/0.60, order accuracy 0.72/0.73, median error 57%/53%; conditional value only

thickness.verdict: not determined: rank correlation 0.08/0.13, order accuracy 0.52/0.57 (coin flip); conditional value only

TS_L.verdict: TS spectral length L (not island D): development CAL only, Ag median 0.92% / P90 7.98% (CAL also used for early stopping; no independent test)

D_over_direct.definition: true D divided by the direct observation 2*pi/q* in the same simulated window (124 of 200 r1 families had a resolved peak)
D_over_direct.use: A D value whose ratio to 2*pi/q* lies outside band_90 is flagged: in simulation only 10% of true D values lie outside it.

conditions: R is the base radius of an equivalent hemisphere (h=R, flat base). Real Ag/Au clusters on polymer are often truncated spheres with h/R between 1 and 2; absolute R depends on this shape condition, trends much less.
D is reported only for windows with a resolved correlation peak; D_corr=2*pi/q* is the direct observation.
Cu is approximated by the Ag model; its numbers are not validated.
Count compatibility does not certify a structure: about 25% of converged simulated cases had D error >30% with the same fit quality.
